_source: Transcribed from the September 2024 menu boards in the WordPress media library (wp-content/uploads/2024/09/1-1, 2-1, 3-1, 4, 5, 6.jpg) on 2026-10-28. Prices exactly as printed. To change the menu, edit this file, then run `npm run menu:pdf` to refresh the downloadable PDF.
_howTo: Each section is one panel. `theme` is its color: green, red or peach. `boards` sets which sections share a printed page and the photo at the top of that page. Put * on an item by setting "advisory": true.
advisory: *Consumer advisory: public health advises that consuming raw or undercooked foods of animal origin, such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, pork, poultry or shellfish, may increase your risk of foodborne illness.
plusNote: A + next to a price means it may vary with larger sizes, added flavoring or special requests.
